column1: # perf_ab — candidate/base per-frame encode wall time (median of paired rounds)
# speedup = base/cand (>1 means the candidate is FASTER). ident=Y: byte-identical output.
# host=r7900x (x86_64-linux, AMD Ryzen 9 7900X, 24 cores), load average 1.35 at
# launch and no other build/sweep running on the box (checked with ps/uptime).
# base = 708ef6386, cand = 708ef6386 + the tx-type-search two-phase restructure.
# AB_ROUNDS=9, gradient, qp 40, tools/perf_ab.sh (interleaved, order randomised
# per round, NEITHER side niced). ident=Y on every cell: the harness compared
# the two OBUs and they are byte-identical, so this is a like-for-like timing.
# The p10 row is the control: TXT search collapses to one candidate there on
# both sides, the screen never exists, and the measured ratio is 1.000.
